high_level_description: The image shows three individuals standing together outdoors in front of a wooden door with white panels. The person on the left is wearing a dark blue t-shirt and black shorts, with a pair of headphones around their neck. They have long hair tied back and appear to be smiling widely. The person in the middle is an older woman dressed in a vibrant orange saree with a floral pattern. She has a traditional bindi on her forehead and is also smiling warmly at the camera. The person on the right is wearing a black Adidas sports jersey with red accents and gold stripes on the shoulders.
